Fit an animal model with a Gibbs sampler

Source: R/lmm_animal_gibbs.R
lmm_animal_gibbs.Rd

Fits a univariate or multivariate linear animal model with fixed effects and relatedness matrix using a single-chain Gibbs sampler. This is intended for quick simulations and checks; its priors differ from those in lmm_animal.

Usage

lmm_animal_gibbs(Y, X = NULL, A, iter = 1000, warmup = floor(iter/2), thin = 1)

Arguments

Y

Numeric response vector or matrix, with individuals in rows. Every trait must vary, and is checked as in lmm_animal.

X

Optional numeric full-column-rank fixed-effects design matrix, with the same rows as Y. The default NULL fits an intercept-only model: one column of ones, named "(Intercept)". Unlike the Stan models, it needs no column representing a constant: the sampler does not shift the response mean through the design.

A

Symmetric positive-semidefinite relationship matrix, with rows and columns in the same individual order as the rows of Y. When both A and Y have row names they are used to put A in the order of Y; names that disagree are an error.

iter

Total number of Gibbs iterations, a whole number.

warmup

Number of initial iterations to discard, a whole number smaller than iter.

thin

Keep every thinth iteration after burn-in, a whole number; warmup + thin must not exceed iter.

Value

A list of posterior draws: G and R are covariance arrays, beta contains fixed-effect matrix draws, h2 contains trait-wise variance ratios, and iterations gives the retained iteration numbers. Quantities are indexed by trait first and draw last, from named dimensions, the layout that back_transform returns as well. fit_draws accepts this list and returns the same layout with R named E, plus the quantities derived from it.

Details

Fixed effects have an improper flat prior. Genetic and residual covariance matrices have inverse-Wishart priors with degrees of freedom K + 1 and scale matrix (K + 1) I / 2, where K is the number of traits. These differ from the priors used by lmm_animal; the resulting posterior draws are not directly interchangeable.
